newsitem.title: NEW ZEALAND: RBNZ assumes 90-day bank bills at 7.5 percent.
newsitem.headline: RBNZ assumes 90-day bank bills at 7.5 percent.

text.p: The Reserve Bank of New Zealand said on Thursday it assumed the 90-day bank bill rate would remain at around 7.5 percent for the entire period covered by its economic projections.
This compared with 9.0 percent assumed in the bank's monetary policy statement in December.
The bank said domestic long term interest rates were generally assumed to move in line with international interest rates with some allowances made for conditions specific to New Zealand.

It said the interest rate assumption, along with an assmption the Trade-Weighted Index would remain constant at 68 over the period, implied slightly easier monetary conditions than the technical assumptions in the December statement.
But it said the assumed level of monetary conditions was effectively unchanged to that described by the bank as being appropriate in the news release that accompanied the December statement.
